newsSince: Eos is raising capital for Frontier Power USA: a $75M direct equity/warrant offering closed July 1 and a rights offering began July 2 to raise up to $150M. FPUSA selected four Texas projects totaling 920 MWh for Eos Z3 technology. The commercial evidence is real, but the financing path is dilutive and execution-heavy.
